### Library loading

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Data retrival

For reproducibility, the dataset was programmatically retrieved from the hbiostat online repository. To do that, we created a local directory where the dataset was stored and loaded into the R environment. Eliminated warnings in case the data directory is already there.

```{r}
dir.create(path = "data", showWarnings = FALSE)

load(url("https://hbiostat.org/data/repo/prostate.rda"))

write_csv(x = prostate, file = "data/prostate_cancer.csv")
```
